content: Standard Oban+PubSub pattern: LiveView mount/3 subscribes to a resource-scoped topic (e.g. "search:#{query_id}"); Oban worker performs the slow work then calls Phoenix.PubSub.broadcast(MyApp.PubSub, topic, {:done, result}); LiveView handle_info/2 reacts and updates assigns/streams. Oban workers can run on the same node (no separate infra) and use Oban.Notifier for lighter progress pings. This is the mechanism to keep embedding generation and LLM query parsing off the request hot path per PROJECT.md's ~50ms rule.
